QuestInfo.name: Cold Milk
QuestInfo.1: #p305# of #m10002000# asked for a beautiful, glittering #b#t4020107##k in exchange for #ba glass of #t4031031##k. A #b#t4020107##k... And just how exactly am I supposed to get such a rare, expensive item?

0.0: So you're here at #p320#'s request, to bring him some #b#t4031031##k? #p320# is the one boy that we have accepted... Hmm, please hold on a second, I'll get you a glass of #t4031031#.
0.1: But then again, I can't give you this just like that. You're also aware that we fairies love fancy, spectacular items, right? If you get me a refined #b#t4020107##k, the #t4031031# is yours.

1.0: Wow...! This is one very well-refined #t4020107#! If you give it to me, I'll give you a glass of the #b#t4031031##k #p320# likes. Will you give the #t4020107# to me?

item.0: Haven't gotten the refined #b#t4020107##k yet? Come to me once you have gotten it. I'll give you a glass of our fairies' pride and joy, #t4031031#.
